title: Dataset migration record
description: Links old gold to new gold across a dataset version boundary. PRD §43.2: 'When an official source changes, a formal dataset migration links old/new gold; past reports stay reproducible.' Without this record a past report's gold citations become unresolvable and the report stops being reproducible, which is the whole reason the record exists.
$comment: CLASSIFICATION is PRD §43.4's regression-classification vocabulary, spelled out here because packages/contracts publishes no family for it — ChangeType (PRD §8.8) is the monitoring change taxonomy and is a different thing. This is dataset-own vocabulary fixed by GOLD-01 deliverable 5, not a second copy of a canonical enum. VOCABULARY: inside the subset contracts.jsonschema_min implements.

reason.description: PRD §14.3's reason. Content-free with respect to blind material: it says what changed upstream, never what a blind case asks.

approved_by.description: PRD §43.4's founder approval for changing an expected output.

classification.description: PRD §43.4's classification of what caused the change.

mappings.description: Per-case old -> new gold. A case whose expected output changed with no mapping here fails VERSIONED_CORRECTIONS.

old_gold.description: The gold authorities as they stood in from_version, kept so a past report resolves.

new_gold.description: The gold authorities as they stand in to_version.
